js.name: JavaScript SIMT Transpiler & Virtual Cluster Engine

kernelLaunch.notes: Arbitrary gridDim and blockDim (up to 1024 threads/block)

sharedMemory.notes: Static and dynamic __shared__ memory with bank conflict detection

syncthreads.notes: Full barrier synchronization with barrier divergence checking

atomics.notes: atomicAdd, atomicSub, atomicMax, atomicMin, atomicCAS, atomicExch, atomicAnd, atomicOr, atomicXor

fp16_bf16.notes: IEEE binary16 and bfloat16 round-to-nearest-even arithmetic and conversions

raceDetector.notes: Barrier-epoch tracking for shared memory RAW, WAR, WAW hazards

desyncDetector.notes: Multi-GPU deadlock, parameter mismatch, and order mismatch detection

sparseVRAM.notes: Sparse page allocator up to 80 GiB per device across 16 GPUs

multiGpuCollectives.notes: ncclAllReduce, ncclBroadcast, ncclReduceScatter, ncclAllGather, ncclReduce, ncclAllToAll, ncclSend, ncclRecv, sub-communicators

printf.notes: CUDA printf formatting with per-thread context

dynamicParallelism.reason: Nested kernel launches inside GPU device code are not supported in client-side environment

inlinePtx.reason: Inline PTX assembly (__asm__) requires physical NVIDIA SASS assembler and is rejected

wmmaTensorCores.reason: WMMA tensor core intrinsics (nvcuda::wmma) require hardware tensor cores and are rejected

cudaGraphs.reason: CUDA Graph execution graph capture (cudaGraphCreate) is not supported
